nodes.label: NEST Service Request Landing Page UI
nodes.description: UI screenshot of the NEST service platform landing page at services.networkingexperts.in. The page features a green-tinted hero section with the headline 'Need help? We’ll be there in minutes.' and a subheading explaining a 3-step service request process via SMS OTP. The right side contains a service request panel with three tabs: New Request, Track Request, and Complaint. The active flow is a 3-step wizard: 1) Verify, 2) OTP, 3) Details. Step 1 prompts the user to enter their mobile number (with +91 country prefix shown) and complete a CAPTCHA quick-check (letter sequence 'X N R U G'). The left side has an ad placeholder. The brand logo 'NEST' appears top-left with dark/light mode and share icons top-right.
ui_patterns: multi-step wizard (3 steps: Verify, OTP, Details)
tabbed navigation (New Request, Track Request, Complaint)
phone number input with country code prefix
design_decisions: Green brand color scheme (dark green text, light green background gradient)
OTP-based phone verification for identity confirmation before service dispatch
CAPTCHA embedded inline within step 1 form
Single-page layout combining hero and interactive form panel
nodes.purpose: Customer-facing service request intake form for dispatching technicians; supports new requests, request tracking, and complaints
